notes.title: 『Stat Storage Feature』Added!
notes.content:
Many players have noted that unlocking all the different endings can be pretty exhausting, so we developed a new feature to help speed up the process!

Patch Notes: -CG fixes for the Prologue/Endings -New Feature: Stat Storage


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320701/cafd1470fc7bd871540a052d21e5bd00c0ee9a37.png"]



After reaching any ending, you can now enter any save file and open the Stat Storage feature. Here, you can spend money to store stats for the fox spirit, and then transfer those values to a different save file. This will make it much easier to explore different endings! Please check the game for full details on how the feature works. Thanks!!!
